FIXED.title: [XX-Fixed Budget-XX]
FIXED.description: [XX-Set a fixed spending limit for each category every period. Any unspent money resets at the end of the period rather than carrying forward.-XX]
cons: [XX-Can feel rigid if spending patterns vary-XX]
FIXED.bestFor: [XX-People who want straightforward budgeting with clear limits and predictable spending patterns.-XX]

ROLLOVER.title: [XX-Rollover Budget-XX]
ROLLOVER.description: [XX-Unspent budget carries forward to the next period based on per-category rollover rules. Build up reserves for categories with irregular or seasonal spending.-XX]
cons: [XX-Can mask overspending if caps are too high-XX]
ROLLOVER.bestFor: [XX-People with irregular expenses like car maintenance, annual subscriptions, or seasonal costs who want to save up gradually.-XX]

ZERO_BASED.title: [XX-Zero-Based Budget-XX]
ZERO_BASED.description: [XX-Every dollar of income is assigned a specific purpose. Your income minus all budgeted amounts should equal zero, ensuring no money is left unallocated.-XX]
ZERO_BASED.bestFor: [XX-People who want total control over their finances and are willing to plan where every dollar goes each period.-XX]

FIFTY_THIRTY_TWENTY.title: [XX-50/30/20 Budget-XX]
FIFTY_THIRTY_TWENTY.description: [XX-A balanced approach that divides income into three groups: 50% for needs (housing, groceries, utilities), 30% for wants (dining, entertainment), and 20% for savings and debt repayment.-XX]
cons: [XX-Fixed ratios may not fit all situations-XX]
FIFTY_THIRTY_TWENTY.bestFor: [XX-People who want a balanced, rule-of-thumb approach without tracking every category individually.-XX]

BUCKET.title: [XX-Bucket Budget-XX]
BUCKET.description: [XX-Income is split into a few named buckets, each with a target that is a share of income or a fixed amount. Every category belongs to one bucket, so you watch the bucket instead of each category. A bucket can carry what is left into the next period.-XX]
pros: [XX-Savings buckets can build up over time-XX]
[XX-Works with irregular spending inside a bucket-XX]
BUCKET.bestFor: [XX-People who find per-category budgets too fiddly but want more structure than 50/30/20.-XX]
